facts.text: Under the Saluki Commitment, SIU pledges to cover whatever tuition and mandatory fees are not covered by a qualifying new or transfer student's financial aid package.
SIU has eliminated out-of-state tuition rates for undergraduate students regardless of which state they call home.
The Saluki Commitment guarantees that tuition and mandatory fees are fully covered for eight consecutive semesters for qualifying freshman students and four semesters for transfer students.
